body: The Summit Overlander camper van—a powerhouse designed to dominate rugged terrains and support off-grid living with ease. Built on a sturdy Sprinter 170 AWD platform, this custom van combines high-end off-road capabilities with every essential for comfortable, self-sufficient adventures.

Equipped with a robust 400W solar system and an 800Ah Lithium Iron battery, the Summit Overlander provides dependable, eco-friendly power for extended journeys. Its 3000W pure sine wave inverter and multiple 110V outlets—including placements for under-sink and overhead access—ensure seamless power access throughout the van. Paired with a 50Amp DC-DC/solar charger combo and 30A shore power plugin, this van is built to keep your devices and appliances running smoothly, no matter where the road leads.

Inside, the Summit Overlander balances functionality with comfort. The kitchen includes an acacia butcher block countertop, a double burner induction cooktop, and an undermount stainless steel sink with hot and cold water. With an Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator/freezer and a 700W microwave, preparing meals on the road is a breeze. For entertainment, the van is equipped with a 24” smart TV on a swivel mount, ideal for movie nights or catching up on the news.

Designed for versatile living, the dinette seating area converts into a sleeping space with custom cushions selected by the client. Climate control features, including a Maxxair Deluxe fan, Nomadic 12V roof-mounted AC, and an Espar diesel heater, ensure comfort in any weather. For on-the-go convenience, the van boasts both an indoor tiled shower and a rear outdoor shower, alongside a 20-gallon water tank and 4-gallon hot water heater.

On the exterior, the Summit Overlander is ready for any adventure with an Agile RIP lift kit, all-terrain wheels, and a CA Tuned front bumper equipped with black D-rings and a Warn 12s winch. The 52” light bar and exterior perimeter lighting provide excellent visibility, while additional features like the Colorado pop top, Owl Vans bike carrier, and Lost Saguaro tire carrier expand storage and utility. Black Rhino Matte Black Arsenal rims complete the rugged, bold aesthetic of this off-road beast.
The Summit Overlander isn’t just a camper van—it’s a mobile sanctuary crafted for those who seek freedom, functionality, and a taste for the extraordinary.
